rationale: B is more useful because it gives a clear substantive recommendation—validator-first with staged rollout—and explains the core decision logic: credibility is the binding constraint for a wealth-tax model. A names a hybrid option but provides almost no comparative reasoning, no clear alternative comparison, and barely any actionable launch guidance. Neither writeup handles uncertainty or quantification well, but B at least includes concrete sequencing and validator counts. A’s KPI mention is not meaningful quantitative support for choosing among options. So despite both being incomplete, B would better help a careful human decide.
